annotations.title: See the Inbox at a glance

description: Reads the figures the Inbox and Home show, one part at a time. part counts returns how many chats are waiting for a person, assigned to the caller, unread, open in all, and have a 24-hour window closing within four hours, per number and in total, with the approvals waiting. part labels returns each label in use on each number with how many open chats carry it. part today returns today’s replies by who sent them (the assistant, people, the phone, automations) and the chats handed to a person, marked Done and opened, in the workspace’s time zone. part week returns replies and new chats for each of the last 7 days. Read-only.

connection_id.description: Only this WhatsApp number; repeat it for several. Omit for every number you can see.

items.description: Only this WhatsApp number; repeat it for several. Omit for every number you can see.

part.description: counts for chats waiting, mine, unread and windows closing; labels for the labels in use; today for today’s replies by who sent them; week for the last 7 days.
